verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms the core Phaser package is published under the MIT license (permissive, no royalties or per-install fees), which aligns with typical open-source game engine licensing; the pricing-page evidence about 'full commercial rights' and license transfer relates to the separate paid Editor product, not the core engine's OSS license. missing for 10: an explicit citation of the LICENSE file or license text, independent community confirmation of no royalty/revenue-share terms, and clarification distinguishing core engine MIT terms from the paid Editor's commercial license.
